snippet.title: The Adventurer | Action platformer | Release trailer | PC & Android
snippet.description:
An action platformer game like Super Mario Bros with simple controls. Run, jump, collect stars, solve puzzles and fight your way through an epic adventure.

Get the game on Itch: https://fahadaameer.itch.io/the-adventurer

Get the game on Play store (free): https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.FahadAameer.TheAdventurer

Follow me on Twitter: https://twitter.com/FahadAameer
